name: wireboard
description: Ask Claude about your website traffic, and let it install WireBoard analytics for you. Query live and historical visitors, top pages, referrers, countries, devices and custom events in plain language. Set up the tracking script, single-page app routing, custom events and a cookie consent flow in any framework, then debug the integration when something looks wrong.

wireboard_token.title: WireBoard API token (optional)
wireboard_token.description: Lets Claude read your analytics. Create one at https://wireboard.io/dashboard/settings/api with the analytics:read and live:read abilities. Leave it empty if you only want Claude to install tracking: you can add it later in /plugin, Installed tab, WireBoard, Configure options.
